newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off lows, focus on Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off lows, focus on Cimpor.

text.p: Portuguese shares closed off the lows in turnover of 8.8 billion escudos and bucked the trend of foreign markets. Operators said some investors took profits, taking advantage of the strong rise of the local market this year. They said Lisbon bourse appeared to be undergoing a period of reflection after the sharp gains recorded since Morgan Stanley promoted it to the status of a developed market. Cimpor shares, which accounted for 27 percent of the total turnover, fell as yesterday was the last day when investors could buy the shares and qualify for dividend payments. Dealers said the trend of the overall bourse in future sessions could depend heavily on the direction of foreign markets. The local market would track U.S. economic indicators closely this week, they said.
